So you want to become an Eater Influencer here in FoodChoo?\n\nHere\'s a few things you need to know before you get started:

1. You need to be fully-verified - so grab your driving license, or passport or ID card for the instant identity check.

2. Once verified, you'll need to give us your bank account details to pay your commission into.

3. Your commissions are eligible for payment 60 days after the completed transaction, and we pay you at the end of each calendar month (this is all shown in the app for total transparency)

4. You agree to not spam your personal FoodChoo Eater Influencer link, or use any illegal or scam-based avenues. If we find out you have, your Eater Influencer account is immediately banned and all your commission is voided. You're going to have a bad legal time, basically. Stick to being legit, have fun and make money.

5. Becoming an FoodChoo Eater Influencer means you agree to being honest about FoodChoo's product, and you're free to use as much creativity as you like in promoting us. Don't overpromise and don't show us in a bad light if you're having a bad day.

Make money with your audience!

Everyone needs to eat, and if you can influence your Followers into buying their menu items from an Establishment on FoodChoo? 

You can earn BIG!

Simple.

You find an Establishment you like or think your Followers would love ordering from.

You see upfront how much per transaction you will make every time one of your Followers orders from this Establishment.

If you agree to this amount, you tap to agree.

That’s it.

Now you’ll get a unique link and QR code to share as you want.

Every time a Follower orders?

You earn $$$

As soon as your Follower buys from an Establishment you’re influencing for, your commission from the Establishment is paid 30 days.

This is a ‘rolling’ 30 day, which simply means after your very first 30 days, if there is commission to pay to you, then you will get that ‘rolling’ commission every day after the initial 30 days.

Oh, and of course you can see at anytime how much you’ve earned.

Pull that commission out to your Bank account anytime via our Payment Partner, Stripe.

Ready to start earning?
